data.name: Natubhai
data.long_meaning: Natubhai is a compound name, consisting of two parts - 'Natu' and 'Bhai'. 'Natu' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nathu', which means 'Lord' or 'Master'. 'Bhai' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhagavan', which means 'God' or 'Lord'. Thus, Natubhai can be translated as 'Lord of the Earth'.
